About Me Research Teaching CV

Hi, I’m Yuqi.

I am a Ph.D. candidate in the NASPO Department of Supply Chain Management at the W. P. Carey School of Business, Arizona State University. I expect to complete my Ph.D. in 2027.

My research focuses on data-driven operational strategy and tactics in online retail. I use analytical modeling and statistical estimation to address operational challenges across different phases of the product life cycle in online marketplaces, including new product development, pricing and revenue management, and product return management.

I am on the 2026–2027 Operations Management job market. I will present my job market paper at the following events:
